mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_auth_refresh_token (id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM t_auth_refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND deleted = 0
